claims.content: The Operator requests Message Digest verification for a given control unit to ensure the integrity of its non-volatile memory items.

goal.raw_text: The Operator requests Message Digest verification for a given control unit to ensure the integrity of its non-volatile memory items.

claims.content: Operator
The system is operational and the control unit to be verified is active.
Valid 'Message Digest' values for each 'Control Unit Non-Volatile Memory' item are stored in non-volatile memory in each system control unit.
The Operator has valid login credentials and access rights to issue operator commands to the system.
The Operator issues a 'Message Digest' verification request for a given control unit.

trigger.raw_text: The Operator issues a 'Message Digest' verification request for a given control unit.

claims.content: The Operator issues a 'Message Digest' verification request for a given control unit by operator command.
For each control unit in the system, the system produces a table of the returned 'one-way hash function' (Message Digest) values of each of the 'Control Unit Non-Volatile Memory' items.
The system performs periodic verification that current, recomputed 'Message Digest' values correspond with 'record' values computed by the development process using the MD5 algorithm.
The 'Message Digest' value verification results are recorded in the system log.
If the failure occurs in checking the non-volatile memory items, the system shall will prevent the affected unit from being used in control sequences.
The 'Message Digest' value verification results are recorded in the system log.
If a verification failure occurs, an alarm condition is triggered for the affected control unit.
If a failure occurs in checking the non-volatile memory items, the system prevents the affected unit from being used in control sequences.
